title: trichilia cuneifolia
intro: Trichilia cuneifolia, commonly known as the narrow-leaved calabash tree, is a plant species in the family Meliaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, and its health benefits include its potential to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Trichilia cuneifolia include its ability to be used in traditional medicine to treat various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
